## bijection_verdict
**KB-BIJECTION RED — KB-B1 (computation-document assembly incomplete).** Symptom: four of this task's computation documents state the result without the source baseline's assembly of factor-decided inputs. Root cause: `baseline.rule` terms "plus the spare sets", "less the amount left out of the plan", "plus the household extension plus the insulin-balance extension, plus or less the plan-history change, less the aged-balance reduction", "less the returned units, never below zero … less the added courtesy percents of that product" and "The courtesy percents add together" (with the zero defaults that make them inert) were not rendered in the computation documents; their effect is expressed only in factor documents, and "add together" is not stated anywhere. Evidence and locations: `infusion_set_quantity_88e87975` clause 6 + step 2; `payment_plan_installment_ad487943` Definitions "Covered balance", "Plan months"; `non_covered_item_charge_amount_f88b1c77` NC-6; `supported_charge_and_reversal_amount_50506ac1` C "Supported charge"; corresponding factor-side carriage in `spare_infusion_sets_after_defects_18ea2e58`, `amounts_excluded_from_a_payment_plan_78086597`, `household_cgm_plan_extension_dc9f2179`, `insulin_pharmacy_balance_extension_bcf21d44`, `earlier_payment_plan_history_467c4f72`, `aged_balance_term_reduction_13844f19`, `returned_units_on_a_denied_line_afeab15e`, `returned_units_in_charge_review_46785cd2`, and the six courtesy docs. Effect on this world: none (blind numbers equal GT); the defect is the location of combination law (a factor document restating the base/assembly, the combination rule left implicit), which the full-domain scan records regardless. Note for the reader of this verdict: the source baselines name factor-decided quantities in their own assembly (see S2), so a complete computation document necessarily mentions those quantities. First revision; no previous revision.

- **KB-XF (round 2) — CLOSED.** No "Standard entries" list, no zero-default sentence naming a factor quantity ("carries no …", "counts no …" → 0 hits), no assembly illustration; the combination is stated once per computation document without naming any factor quantity. A reader who found only the reading factor still computes from the standard quantity; one who found both applies the replacement first — which is what GT does.
